outcome.answer: Yes—these results include several graph-ML papers on chemical reactions. The closest direct match is [1], which uses a condensed reaction graph and contrastive learning for reaction representation learning and yield prediction, explicitly comparing against graph-based baselines. [2] is also about reaction prediction, but it focuses on compact LLMs with atom-map invariance and curriculum learning rather than graph representations. [6] uses a graph-to-sequence predictor for biodegradation pathway prediction with synthetic reaction data, which is related but not centered on general chemical reaction graph learning.
